rules: Reuse the Q2 2025 rule: national weekly finished-gasoline demand proxy, 364-day alignment, observed QTD growth scaling for unavailable current weeks, uniform daily rates within weeks.
Use exact ALFRED cutoff snapshots, historical issuer releases published by cutoff, and the latest available 10-K store-count weights for the same three regions.
Keep alpha=2, quarterly four-feature change regression and 0.5 shrinkage; no parameter searches or outcome-conditioned rule changes.
Apply the same quarterly-to-remaining-period transfer assumption to the period after the disclosed completed month, using persistence for unavailable complete paired weekly prices.

Approximately stated finite retail numbers can be represented by the stated value only in an explicitly approximate research replay; do not treat them as audited exact actuals or invent uncertainty bounds.
A named calendar month completed before the call is interpreted as that completed month's start and end. A still-open month without an explicit coverage end remains blocked.
Open-ended bounds such as north of 21 cents do not identify a central estimate; all-in-only or qualitative disclosures cannot anchor a retail estimate.
Freeze every prediction and input hash before separate scoring. Known outcomes mean this is not blind or prospective validation.

For the current quarter only, if production has no complete quarter weeks, retain its blocked state. Show the prior-year seasonal reference and a separately labelled full-quarter flat-price research shadow, with zero observed quarter weeks.

cases.required_text: retail only margins were in the neighborhood of $0.19 per gallon
